title: DisasterAgent: An Evidence-Driven Agent for Verifiable Disaster Report Generation From Remote Sensing Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2611.13776v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Remote sensing disaster assessment is moving from simple damage classification toward comprehensive report-level analysis. In this setting, responders need not only damage descriptions but also verifiable evidence to guide response and recovery. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) and tool-augmented agents offer strong multimodal reasoning and perception, but they struggle to provide the evidence required for high-stakes verification. To address these limitations, we propose DisasterAgent, an evidence-driven agent that uses a Perception-Augmentation-Generation workflow to generate verifiable disaster reports from bitemporal optical imagery. DisasterAgent first invokes a specialized vision expert toolkit in the perception phase to build a Spatiotemporal Perception Graph (STPG), serving as a structured memory to store and organize disaster-induced changes across space and time. translated_title: DisasterAgent：一种基于证据驱动的、可从遥感影像生成可验证灾害报告的智能体
translated_abstract: 遥感灾害评估正从简单的损害分类向综合的报告级分析发展。在这一背景下，应急救援人员不仅需要损害描述，还需要可验证的证据来指导响应与恢复工作。近期的视觉语言模型（VLM）和工具增强智能体虽然具备强大的多模态推理与感知能力，但它们难以提供高风险验证所需的证据。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了DisasterAgent，这是一个证据驱动的智能体，它采用“感知-增强-生成”工作流，从双时相光学影像中生成可验证的灾害报告。DisasterAgent首先在感知阶段调用专门的视觉专家工具包，构建时空感知图（STPG），作为结构化记忆来存储和组织灾害在空间和时间上引起的变化。随后，基于证据的增强（EA）从……中提取证据
tldr: 提出了证据驱动的智能体DisasterAgent，通过“感知-增强-生成”工作流、视觉专家工具包和时空感知图（STPG），从双时相遥感影像中生成附带可验证证据的灾害报告。
en_tdlr: DisasterAgent is an evidence-driven agent that generates verifiable disaster reports from bitemporal remote sensing imagery via a Perception-Augmentation-Generation workflow, using a specialized vision expert toolkit and a Spatiotemporal Perception Graph (STPG) to provide verifiable evidence for high-stakes disaster assessment.
